payload.focus: Default Ref Test — testing that omitted ref creates a topic branch
payload.rationale: The document is a minimal test memory by Tanya (staging) verifying that an omitted git ref defaults to topic-branch creation. I expanded all focus-scoped witnesses: the sample record, the Narrative_DefaultRefTopicBranch it instantiates, Tanya's verbatim observation, her actor profile, and the three style observations (metrics, jargon, direct tone). I also expanded Position_Sprint4ThesisProven because its zero-effort-capture frame — the system automatically creating a persistent artifact — directly parallels the automatic topic-branch behavior this test exercises. Narrative_AntiSlackPositioning and two of its children (Position_AntiPatternRealtimeChat, Position_ProductCategoryAsyncPlatform) were expanded to give the passes the product-vision context that motivates the system under test. I deliberately did NOT expand Position_PricingTwelveDollars or Position_TargetMarketRemoteTeams — pricing and segmentation have no bearing on a git-ref defaulting test.
